verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform with AI features (Sona, call summaries, transcription, AI call tags), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains no statement about model-training data use, an opt-out control, or a no-training commitment. The AI-feature and API documentation is adjacent at best and earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
